content: IPol kye inɛ byi okwakye mgbi engyukwo emi iJuda yɛyɛ si gbɛɛ, <<Emi engwunani, ani kyidɔ mgbi ani mbi Imgbasho mi itukwu asisa nghataa ba inɛ.>>
Mi odzɛ nɛ okwukwo inggisɛ ofifɛ Anania nu ama nkwulɛsɛ to kwɛkwɛ yi iPol ondu gbɛɛ nu ma gbobun ondu.
Nɛ iPol nya Anania gbɛɛ, <<Imgbasho ka ta abu afɛ, abu inggisɛ ikpala nɛni! Abu sɔ mmana le gbɔ ani ikwɔ mi odzɛɛdzɛ mgbi Ola, nghaduu abu abuabu foola mi onu ondu gbɛɛ nu ma ta ani afɛ!>>
Ama nkwudzɛ yi iPol ntona byun gbɛɛ, <<Abu shitukwu le fya okwukwo inggisɛ ofifɛ mgbi Imgbasho itoo?>>
IPol gbɛɛ, <<Engwunani, ani yama ye gbɛɛ o li okwukwo inggisɛ ofifɛ ba, lubana a lɔ gbɛɛ, <Ka gbɔdzɛ obube ikpewo inggisɛ ogbe emidabu teyi ba.> >>

Ngwi iPol ye gbɛɛ angbeka li emi iSadusi angbeka di li emi iFarasi nɛ, o makwɔ yi okwakye mgbi engyukwo ntona gbɛɛ, <<Emi ongwunani, ani li inggisɛ iFarasi, di li ongwɛ inggisɛ iFarasi. A le gbɔ ani ikwɔ ikyegbɛɛ ani kye eka byi okyɛɛ-kyɛɛ mi ikwongye.>>
Onɔ ngwi o gbɔdzɛ nɛ ngha nɛ, odzɛ oshiishi tɔ mi idzidzɛ mgbi emi iFarasi bɛyi emi iSadusi, man okwakye na gheefa.
(Emi iSadusi noyɛyɛ gbɛɛ okyɛɛ-kyɛɛ mi ikwu, bɛyi engyesɔ naadi emi onodzi dzɛma ba, kpaa emi iFarasi noyɛyɛ mi ungwɔ ntonɛ duu.)

Odzɛ oshiishi yɛɛ okwukwo nɛman etsetse mgbi ola angbeka ama nli emi iFarasi tokɛ unto di tangwɛ kpɔklɔɔ gbɛɛ, <<Eyi tu unkonyi obube mbi inggisɛ nɛ ba,>> A byi ma gbɛɛ, <<Ni li onodzi hona ongyesɔ gbɔdzɛ yan ma yɛ?>>
Odzɛ oshiishi na yɛɛ eye man okwukwo ogbakwu na mio gbɛɛ a ka kyi fwalu iPol ambulu-ambulu. O woola gbɛɛ oblakwutsɛ nu ma ka kyen kyi gbɛlu mi abɔ mfye yilen luba ogalu oblakwutsɛ.
Mi otu ongwi egbe na Otsɛ wa dzɛkɛ yi iPol nyan gbɛɛ, <<Fyumfye itukwu! Dafi abu gbɔdzɛ mgbi ani mi iJerosalin na, li ngha ngwi abu dika gbɔ kyɛmɛ mi igeli iRoma aali.>>
A wibu ongwɔ iPol
Mi egbegbe nɛ emi iJuda kwakye di bwalu ondu mi ofaafa gbɛɛ ama ka gye hona wa ungwɔ ba sede ama ngwɔlu iPol.
Inggisɛ ngha ngwusefa ama nwodzɛ mi ondu obwa-bwa nɛni.
A kɛ mbi engyukwo ama ofifɛ bɛyi engyukwo emi iJuda ka nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Eyi bwa mi ofaafa kpɔklɔɔ gbɛɛ eyi ka gye unkonyi ba sede eyi ngwɔlu iPol.
Nghawanɛ, ema yi okwakye mgbi engyukwo emi iJuda dɛsɔ mbi okwukwo ogbakwu mi ikpala no kyen ba mbi ema gbɛɛ, i mina ema ofwo itɔdzɛ saan mi odzɛ mgban. Eyi wewo ogbongwɔn duuse no wa to mmɛnɛni.>>
Kpaa ngwi ongwɛ ongwunɔ iPol fwo ngha nɛ, o lu ogalu oblakwutsɛ ka nya iPol.
Ta iPol kwu ongyukwo oblakwutsɛ ntona onyi ela nyan gbɛɛ, <<Kye ongwummafa nɛ kɛ mbi okwukwo ogbakwu, o dzɛ yi odzimɔ onyan.>>
Nghanɛ o kyon kɛ mbi okwukwo ogbakwu nani. O nyan gbɛɛ, <<IPol inggisɛ mi obawi na dɛsɔ mbi ani nya ani gbɛɛ ni ani kye mmafa nɛ ba mbi abu ikyekyɛ o dzɛ yi odzimɔ onya abu.>>
Okwukwo ogbakwu na byi ongwongyulɔ mmafa na abɔ, kwon lu enggengga si byun gbɛɛ, <<Li ali odzɛ ngwi abu dzɛyan onya ani?>>
O nyan gbɛɛ, <<Emi iJuda bwondu onya abu ni abu kye iPol ba okwakye mgbi engyukwo emi iJuda ekeka mi ɛwɛ gbɛɛ ama mina oye itɔdzɛ yɛyɛ mi odzɛ mgban.
Ka gbela yi ma ba, ikyesinɛ inggisɛ ngha ngwusefa da to oshɛ le fan. A fa gbɛɛ ama ka gye hona wa ungwɔ ba sede ama ngwɔ iPol. A wewo ngyɛ onɛnɛ le fɛ ogbela-gbela mgbi abu mi oweka mgbi ama.>>
Okwukwo ogbakwu na wo ongyulɔ mmafa na ofɛ di kwon adɔ gbɛɛ, <<Ka nya inggisɛ onyi kpaa gbɛɛ di abu nya ani odzɛ nɛ loo.>>
A nyinɛ iPol lu iSidzaria

Ta o kwu engyukwo mgbi ama oblakwutsɛ efa ela si nu ma ondu gbɛɛ, <<Gbe oblakwutsɛ ideli efa yi ama otɔ mmya ngwuseta dɔn iwyo bɛyi emi ashɔ ideli efa nu ma wewo okɛ iSisiria mi obyi egyanɛ mi otu inɛ.
Di wewo yi mmya angbeka nka kye iPol kɛ mbi iGɔna iFelisi saan mani.>>
O lɔ afɛ sini:
IKladiɔsu iLisia, Ugabaidu, iGɔna iFelisi: N ta abu angba.
Inggisɛ nɛ emi iJuda bwan di wewo ongwɔn, kpaa ani ba yi ibyi oblakwutsɛ wa nagban, ikyekyɛ ani fwo gbɛɛ o li imba mgbi iRoma.
Ani mina oye ungwɔ ngwi a le gbe odzɛ tukwun ewo mani, nghanɛ ani kyon ba mbi okwakye mgbi engyukwo emi iJuda.
Man ani wa difwi gbɛɛ a le gbe odzɛ tukwun ewo mi ikye ola mgbi ama, nghaduu itɔdzɛ onyi ngwi a nu ngwi mɛ ongwɔn hona kyen wo obawi dzɛma ba.
Onɔ ngwi a nya ani ungwɔ ngwi a kye weka okyɔ yi inggisɛ nɛ mata, ani kyon dɛsɔ lu mbi abu akponyi. Ani di nu ondu gbɛɛ ama ngbe odzɛ tukwun ewo ntona nu ma gbɔ itɔdzɛ mgbi ama ma nya abu.
Nghanɛ oblakwutsɛ ntona kyidɔ ngwi a nu ma ondu mani, a kye iPol wafɔ yi ama kyon lu byulu kaka Antipatri mi otu nani.
Tegblifan ma emi mmya tawon lu kpaa emi afɛɛsɛ yɔ yidɔ luba ogalu mgbi oblakwutsɛ.
Ngwi emi mmya ntona ka kaka iSisiria nɛ, a kye afɛ ma nu iGɔna di kye iPol kpaa won abɔ.
IGɔna gbɔ afɛ na si byita ayɛsɛ ngwi o kyɛ ele mani. Ngwi o difwi gbɛɛ o kyɛ mi iSilisia nɛ,
o gbɛɛ, <<Ani ka fwo odzɛ mgbi abu mi onɔ ngwi ama ngbe odzɛ tukwu abu ewo kaka mmɛnɛ mani.>> Ta o wo ma ola gbɛɛ nu ma kye iPol lu udɛ utɔ iHerude ka ngyon.
